description: Codex in mode agent whose account refuses Codex's reviewer. The first launch's prompt is refused before its turn starts; the client must switch to workspace-write and send the prompt once more, answered 'Asked first.'. A later launch of the same agent in the host's run must switch to workspace-write before its first prompt, answered 'Asked first again.'; the branch picks by method.

note: The first launch sends its prompt in mode agent and is refused; a later launch of the same agent starts in workspace-write; the branch picks by method.

one_of.note: codex 0.162.1 refuses the turn's approvalsReviewer before it starts (config/src/config_requirements.rs:1863-1871, app-server turn_processor.rs:884-904); codex-acp's SDK answers a thrown error as -32603 with its message under data.details (dist/index.js:25697-25708).

data.details: invalid thread settings override: invalid value for `approvals_reviewer`: `AutoReview` is not in the allowed set [User] (set by MDM managed_config.toml)
